scope: Reviewer repair for initial nonmana acquired-activation legality. No card definitions, admissions, generated artifacts, public wire, or owned state changes.
finding: Readiness qualified each acquired once-per-turn/exhaust instance by its immutable grant timestamp, but initial funding rebuilt a FundingGoal without that packet. The prefunded can_fund_for path and FundingState then applied unrelated printed/copied slot use. Unused acquired instances were incorrectly absent from legal actions.
repair: Build the existing immutable acquired activation packet before initial funding.
Use its existing payment Announcement, cost routes and target-dependent total calculation.
Set that exact payment context on the borrowed FundingState before the normal reachable-with-evidence search, preserving independent source usage and additional-cost witnesses.
Retain the printed-activation fast path. No Game clone, temporary real-state mutation, new identity inference, or clearing of actual slot history.

rules_reference.principle: Each acquired activated instance has its own activation restrictions, costs and use history. Target/cost choices use the same immutable activation through payment.

representation.cost: One existing immutable packet/payment context and borrowed funding preview per acquired nonmana initial cost route; ordinary activation funding unchanged.
